# opusdns_zones (Data Source)

Fetches the list of all DNS zones in your OpusDNS account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opusdns_zones" "all" {}

output "zone_names" {
  value = [for z in data.opusdns_zones.all.zones : z.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `created_after` (String) Filter zones created after this RFC3339 timestamp.
- `created_before` (String) Filter zones created before this RFC3339 timestamp.
- `dnssec_status` (String) Filter by DNSSEC status (`enabled` or `disabled`).
- `include_tags` (Boolean) When true, request `include=tags` and populate the computed `tags` field for each zone.
- `name` (String) Filter by exact zone name.
- `search` (String) Free-text search over zone names.
- `suffix` (String) Filter by domain suffix, such as `.com`.
- `tag_ids` (List of String) Filter by tag IDs. Multiple values are sent as repeated `tag_ids` query parameters.
- `tag_mode` (String) Tag filter mode. Use `match_any` or `match_all` according to the API.
- `updated_after` (String) Filter zones updated after this RFC3339 timestamp.
- `updated_before` (String) Filter zones updated before this RFC3339 timestamp.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A static identifier for this data source.
- `zones` (Attributes List) The list of DNS zones. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `created_on` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the zone was created.
- `dnssec_status` (String) The DNSSEC status of the zone.
- `name` (String) The domain name of the zone.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags assigned to the zone when `include_tags` is true. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones--tags))
- `updated_on` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the zone was last updated.
- `vanity_nameserver_set_id` (String) The id of the vanity nameserver set (`vns_...`) branding this zone, or null when the zone uses OpusDNS system defaults.
- `zone_id` (String) Server-assigned DNS zone id (`dns_zone_id`).

<a id="nestedatt--zones--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones.tags`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String)
- `label` (String)
- `tag_id` (String)
